verdict.rationale: Formant's agent, installable on ROS 1 and ROS 2 devices, streams configurable telemetry data streams to the cloud. The platform claims instant visibility into every robot, current status, realtime visualizations and an Observe view, so remote inspection of live robot state is documented. Remote debugging is further supported by peer-to-peer WebRTC sessions, port forwarding of on-device web pages, and a run-script command. missing for 10: explicit evidence of browsing live ROS topics, any documented remote log viewing/streaming, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the debugging workflow.
